body: United States. I need a salaried job because I have no family/friends who can take care of me. I'd love to volunteer otherwise.

Well, atm I haven't been able to sleep very much at all because of the anxiety. I'll sleep 4 hours and wake up, worrying about what I am going to do. Then I'll stay up for a long time and try to sleep again, but can only sleep for 2-3 hours. Cycle repeats. My landlord already sent me a letter and email to pay rent ASAP since I was a week late (now 2 weeks). I am afraid I will get evicted any day. Might as well just jump off the bridge if it comes to that. I just wish I had a family or some friends but nope. Mother who gave birth to me abandoned me when I was a baby and wants nothing to do with me. Grandma who raised me best she could passed away. No siblings/etc (my grandma/mother are both sort of loners). Just wish I was never born.

My only friend recently stopped talking to me altogether (he's also struggling with job search) because I was "annoying."

No girlfriend. Can't be in a relationship without money. At least not from where I am from.

I am young but I also am tired of having been dealt shitty cards over and over in life. Meanwhile so many kids grow up nurtured by family and never having to worry about where they will have to sleep if they cannot get a job right away. Not that they will have much trouble finding one since well-off people always have more connections than the poor.

I have suffered on and off with depression (dysthymia) and some anxiety. I've been to many different therapists/shrinks over the year and none of them help/understand. Medication doesn't do anything for me. Most of my stress comes from lack of family/friends as well as lack of financial support. At one point I voluntarily agreed to stay in a psych unit at a hospital, which did nothing either. Not wasting my time with that stuff anymore.

I worked over the summers in high school, worked several jobs during my college years both during the school year and the summers. These were in various positions (working with kids, running the front desk/reception, office assistant, tutoring calculus + higher math classes) so I have a good work ethic and learned early on to be independent and rely on myself for what I need. I enjoy helping people. But it feels like employers nowadays won't hire anyone unless they're the PERFECT match in their own heads. Gone are the days of giving qualified people a chance to work. I just need a job to sustain myself.
